lion.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game animation sprite sheet.
Create ONE consistent six-frame ACTION SPRITE SHEET of the exact lion in the reference: golden coat, dark brown full mane, cream muzzle/chest, slender tufted tail, same painted cartoon outlines and shading. All face strictly LEFT, full body visible.
Layout: exactly THREE columns and TWO rows in a clean equal-cell grid. Transparent gutters separate all six characters; no borders, text, labels, objects, ground, shadows, mud or water.
Column 1 both rows: horizontal swimming/paddling lion, head lifted, body low and horizontal, hind legs bent, forelegs down; top row front paws reach forward/down, bottom row paws sweep backward under chest. These two frames form a paddling cycle.
Column 2 both rows: lion hanging upright diagonally, BOTH front legs extending high overhead, curled front paws at one shared grip point above head, bent rear legs dangling off ground, tail trailing. Top row reaching to grab, bottom row securely gripping; leave the vine itself absent so the game can draw it to the paws.
Column 3 both rows: lion tucked into a compact crouch with all four legs folded near chest and belly, rounded silhouette for a forward tumble, head still facing left, mane and tail close to body; top row tight tuck, bottom row relaxed landing crouch.
Preserve exact animal identity, coat colors, proportions, painted rendering and crisp readable silhouettes. Each column is a different required obstacle animation. Real transparent background. No extra animals, no scenery or props. Wide sheet, evenly spaced characters.
